title: Immersion pullback preserves mixed and complex upper weights
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an isomorphism $\iota:\Qlb\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf C$. For a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $S_0$ put $S=S_0\times_{k_0}k$. Use the common-stage coefficient category $D^b_c(S,\Qlb)$ and its constructible heart [def-weil-constructible-heart]. Weil objects and equivariant morphisms are fixed pairs as in [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Mixed upper bounds and $D_{\le w}(S_0)$ have the meanings of [def-weil-punctual-weights; def-weil-complex-weights].

Let $h_0:W_0\hookrightarrow X_0$ be a locally closed immersion of separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, meaning a closed immersion followed by an open immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion; def-weil-open-immersion]. Let $h$ be its base change to $k$ and $h^*$ the derived coefficient pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], with its induced Weil structure and its restriction to the constructible heart. For every $w\in\mathbf R$:
1. If a constructible Weil sheaf $F$ on $X_0$ is $\iota$-mixed of weights at most $w$, then $h^*F$ is $\iota$-mixed of weights at most $w$.
2. If $K\in D_{\le w}(X_0)$, then $h^*K\in D_{\le w}(W_0)$.
The finite filtrations in the first assertion may have repeated terms; no strictness of their inclusions is required.

It preserves the zero first term and monomorphisms; its cokernel comparison identifies successive quotients with pulled-back pure quotients. Purity is invariant under a heart isomorphism simply by precomposing its finite Weil presentation. Retain each quotient weight and its upper inequality.

lean.statement: theorem zlImmersionPullbackWeightPreservation (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p) (Qbar : Type v) [Field Qbar] [Algebra (Padic l) Qbar] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Qbar] (iota : Qbar ≃+* ℂ) (W₀ X₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))) [LocallyOfFiniteType W₀.hom] [QuasiCompact W₀.hom] [IsSeparated W₀.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom] [IsSeparated X₀.hom] (h₀ : W₀ ⟶ X₀) [IsImmersion h₀.left] (w : ℝ) : (∀ F : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl X₀ Qbar, SfIsMixedOfWeightsAtMost D l hl Qbar X₀ iota.toRingHom F w → SfIsMixedOfWeightsAtMost D l hl Qbar W₀ iota.toRingHom ((zlWeilPull D l hl Qbar h₀).obj F) w) ∧ (∀ K : sfCommonStageWeilComplex D l hl X₀ Qbar, SfComplexIsMixedOfWeightsAtMost D l hl Qbar X₀ iota.toRingHom K w → SfComplexIsMixedOfWeightsAtMost D l hl Qbar W₀ iota.toRingHom ((IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIso (zlFrobeniusSquare D l hl Qbar h₀)).obj K) w)
lean.note: Uses the existing common-stage upper-bound predicate SfComplexIsMixedOfWeightsAtMost (sk-d-dl-general-weights) and normalized canonical Weil pullback zlWeilPull / zlFrobeniusSquare (def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category); those two already-landed statement dependencies are added. No alternate Weil category, upper-bound definition, or arbitrary equivariance datum is introduced.
